full_prompt_en: A botanical paper-collage still life presents a gathered flowering branch against an uninterrupted velvet-black ground. Near the lower center, a broad open pink blossom anchors the arrangement, its overlapping petals cut into soft irregular lobes and shaded from blush at the tips to deeper rose near the folds. Above it sits a larger white many-petaled bloom, slightly left of center, with pale gray seams separating its narrow layered petals. A smaller orange flower with a dense yellow center interrupts the white and pink, while light-blue star-shaped flowers gather near the upper right. Fine green stems connect these larger masses to tiny buds, white sprays, ocher seed heads, and dark olive leaves. The stems cross lightly and asymmetrically; the bouquet rises into the upper half while a few leaves and small white flowers extend outward into empty black space. Each petal and leaf has a sharply cut silhouette but a softly modeled interior, as though individually colored paper fragments have been assembled into a precise natural-history study. Minute shifts in tone, faint fibers, and tiny overlaps keep the surface tactile rather than flat digital color. The brightest whites form the upper visual peak, the pink flower provides a broad warm base, and the blue and orange accents separate into smaller opposing clusters. Gentle frontal illumination catches pale petals without creating cast scenery or a visible setting. The dense, near-black background makes every fine edge legible and lends the arrangement a quiet, luminous depth. The composition feels exacting and ornamental, with botanical variety held together by a deliberate rhythm of branching lines and luminous color islands.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅植物纸拼贴静物在不间断的丝绒黑底上呈现一枝集合花枝。下方中央附近，一朵敞开的宽大粉花稳住布局，重叠花瓣裁成柔和不规则裂片，从瓣尖淡粉到褶皱处深玫瑰色层层着色。其上方中央偏左是一朵更大的多瓣白花，狭长层叠花瓣之间以浅灰细缝区分。一朵有浓密黄蕊的小橙花打断白与粉的关系，浅蓝色星形小花则聚在右上。细绿茎把这些大块连接到微小花苞、白色花枝、赭黄种穗和深橄榄绿叶片。枝茎轻轻交错而不对称；花束向画面上半部伸展，少量叶片与白色小花探入空旷黑域。每片花瓣和叶都有锐利裁切的外轮廓，内部却柔和塑形，仿佛独立上色的纸片被拼装成精确的博物学图谱。细微色阶、淡淡纸纤维和小小叠压让表面保持可触质地，而不是平板数字色。最亮的白花形成上部视觉峰值，粉花提供宽阔温暖的底座，蓝与橙作为较小的对向色簇分开。温柔正面光照亮浅色花瓣，却不产生场景投影或可见环境。浓密近黑背景使每条细边都清晰，并赋予花枝安静发光的深度。构图精密且富装饰性，分枝线的节奏和明亮色岛把繁多植物形态凝聚在一起。
style_prompt_en: A meticulous botanical paper-collage treatment sets finely cut, overlapping shapes against a continuous near-black matte field. Silhouettes are crisp and minutely irregular, while interiors carry delicate tonal grading, faint paper fibers, and shallow layered relief. Large pale cream and blush forms create the main visual masses; smaller vermilion, powder-blue, ocher, and olive accents punctuate them with controlled spacing. Hair-thin branching lines join dense clusters to isolated small marks, allowing generous black intervals around each group. Light appears soft and frontal, brightening the pale areas without theatrical shadows, while subtle gray seams define overlapping layers. The surface reads as carefully assembled hand-colored fragments, precise in botanical detail yet warm and tactile. Asymmetrical vertical growth, varied scales, and clustered color islands establish an ornamental rhythm across the dark ground, with the emptiness as active compositional space.
style_prompt_zh: 精细的植物纸拼贴处理把细致裁切、彼此叠压的形状置于连续的近黑哑光底面上。外轮廓清晰而有微小不规则，内部带细腻色阶、淡纸纤维和浅浅分层浮起感。大块浅奶油白与淡粉形成主视觉体量，较小的朱红、粉蓝、赭黄和橄榄绿点缀其间，间距克制。发丝般细的分枝线将浓密簇群与孤立小笔点相接，让每组周围保留宽裕黑色间隔。光线柔和而正面，照亮浅色区域而没有戏剧投影，微妙灰色接缝划分重叠层。表面像精心拼装的手工着色碎片，植物细节精确却温暖可触。不对称的纵向生长、大小变化和成簇色岛在深底上建立装饰节奏，留白本身也积极参与构图。
theme_en: A carefully arranged flowering branch with varied blossoms against a dark ground
theme_zh: 深色底面上由多种花朵组成的精细花枝
name: Mary Delany
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
